name: @multi-ai-coder/desktop
description: Desktop coding IDE: a premium orchestrator (Claude Code / Codex) coordinating local coding models.
author: Multi-AI Coder

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @multi-ai-coder/shared build && pnpm --filter @multi-ai-coder/plugin-sdk build && pnpm --filter @multi-ai-coder/agents build && pnpm --filter @multi-ai-coder/engine build && pnpm --filter @multi-ai-coder/api build && pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run build:main && node scripts/make-icon.mjs && pnpm run build:renderer
scripts.package: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:dir: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir
